guarantees.claim: For each of the five mode values AES_ECB, AES_CBC, AES_CFB, AES_OFB, AES_CTR, ctrl_wd.mode is assigned the identical value.
guarantees.cond: when mode matches one of the five explicit case items

guarantees.claim: For any mode value not matching an explicit case item (including unsupported codes, X, or Z), ctrl_wd.mode is assigned AES_NONE.
guarantees.cond: mode is not equal to AES_ECB, AES_CBC, AES_CFB, AES_OFB, or AES_CTR

uncertain_points.claim: Illegal mode values are silently mapped to AES_NONE without driving an error output or alert. There is no hardware signal to indicate the mode register has become corrupted or fallen outside the supported set.
uncertain_points.cond: if mode flips to an unsupported value due to a soft error, glitch, or active attack
uncertain_points.risk: The AES module may stop operating (AES_NONE) without any integrity or error indication, possibly masking a fault or allowing a denial-of-service condition to go undetected.
